approval.prompt: Original image-to-3D concept for faceted waterfront FPS. Single coherent isolated game prop centered on plain light grey background, full object visible in three-quarter front view. Clean broad triangulated flat-shaded geometry, one solid colour per material, no grain, dirt, outlines, drawn seams, logos, text, people, floor or surrounding scenery. Believable construction, strong readable silhouette. A compact freestanding bar display: a dark walnut lower cabinet and three open tiers of chunky differently shaped muted bottle silhouettes in amber and deep olive with ivory label areas but no writing. Width1.6m height1.85m depth0.4m.
